mapper.sql: id, news_id, user_id, content, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, create_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into Comment (news_id, user_id, content, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, create_time, deleted) values (#{newsId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{content,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{parentId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{replyToUserId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 0)
mapper.select: select from Comment where news_id = #{newsId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and deleted = 0 order by create_time asc

select c.*, u.username, ru.username as reply_to_username from Comment c left join User_Inf u on c.user_id = u.id left join User_Inf ru on c.reply_to_user_id = ru.id where c.news_id = #{newsId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and c.deleted = 0 order by c.create_time asc
